title: Military Cadets Marching at Campus Ceremony, 1966 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot developed in March 1966 showing a formal outdoor procession of uniformed military personnel or cadets walking in line down a wide paved pathway. Spectators in mid-1960s suits, overcoats, and dresses look on from folding chairs and the sidelines. In the background stands a prominent mid-century modern multistory grid building and an arcade colonnade under bright, clear skies.
